concept: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 시각 의미 데이터의 대체 표현을 추가/보강하는 작업을 중심으로 진행하고 후보 데이터에도 잘 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

prompt_en: A complex editorial photograph catches a single photographic moment in a night greenhouse adjoining a specimen archive. A fictional adult woman dressed for an after-hours botanical salon lowers a small flowering begonia toward a wheeled specimen trolley; the supplied portrait guides her visible facial appearance, including softly rounded facial contours, dark rounded almond eyes, a softly shaped nose, and full bowed lips. Her own invented styling has a hime cut: straight black hair with blunt jaw-length sidelocks ending sharply beside both cheeks, a straight eyebrow-level fringe, and a distinct longer back layer falling below her shoulders. A slim black headband arcs across her crown and carries two triangular felt cat ears as a wearable accessory. She wears a garnet satin dress with a square neckline. Two opposed vertical rows of metal eyelets frame the bodice opening, a black cord threads repeatedly across the opening in clear X-shaped crossings and ends in a small tied bow. The knee-length outer skirt flares over a separate gathered ivory petticoat; the petticoat's layered ruffled hem visibly extends below the satin hem and supports its rounded volume. Her left palm supports the pot's saucer while her right fingers steady the terracotta side; the pot stays beside her left thigh, just above the trolley's low shelf, leaving the bodice front readable. Her feet rest on the level aisle, her torso stays comfortably upright, and she turns her face toward the camera with a quiet, inviting expression. A dry pressed leaf on an archival sheet lies on the trolley near the living plant. Glass-front storage shelves recede behind her, roof trusses frame the dark night sky, and broad greenhouse leaves occupy the far edge. A warm task lamp gives the face and satin gentle lustre against cool teal archive light. An eye-level, head-to-toe vertical composition keeps her facial appearance, separated hair lengths, headband construction, lacing, and both skirt layers readable, with natural photographic texture and restrained background detail.
